manifest.name: dsh-advisor-group
manifest.description: 让一个会话既能向其他模型借智慧，也能向其他会话借记忆。遇到专业、长尾世界知识、高风险或不确定的问题，主模型召集多位专家顾问模型，在复古 CRT 聊天组卡片中进行会诊；遇到别的会话已经知道的事，跨会话去问，复用已有上下文，无需从头再查。

readme.text:
> 让 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的一个会话，既能**向其他模型借智慧**，也能**向其他会话借记忆**。

[English](README.en.md) · [安装](#兼容性与安装) · [快速开始](#快速开始) · [核心功能](#核心功能) · [配置参考](#配置参考) · [开发](#开发)

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-advisor-group)
[](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[](LICENSE)

| 能力 | 它帮你做什么 |
| --- | --- |
| **多模型会诊（顾问群）** | 面对专业、高风险或没有把握的问题，让多位专家模型接力回答，再由驱动模型汇总结论。 |
| **跨会话协作（全局蜂群）** | 直接询问另一个已有会话，复用它读过的代码、做过的排查和定下的约定，不必从零再来。 在本会话子代理功能之外，提供模型跨项目写作的能力。|
| **顾问团角色卡** | 给会话分配姓名和职责。之后直接说“去问小明”，不必记会话标题或 sessionId。 |

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | 当前开发基线为 `0.2.1-rc.3`；声明可安装的版本范围（peer）为 `>=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0` |
| Node.js | 从源码构建时需要 `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| 使用端 | DSH Web 与桌面端，共用同一份客户端代码包 |

声明范围内的更早版本没有逐一实装验证。跨会话功能还需要宿主提供会话控制服务 `sessionController`；缺少该服务时，相关工具会明确报错，多模型会诊不受影响。

DSH Web：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-advisor-group
```

安装后按你原来的方式重启 DSH Web，并硬刷新浏览器（`Ctrl+Shift+R`）。

**桌面端**：在应用内打开 **Plugins → Add plugin**，输入 `dsh-advisor-group`。桌面端的配置清单由应用管理，`dsh plugin --profile desktop …` 会被官方拒绝，这不是权限不足。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/xingzhen199186/dsh-advisor-group.git
cd dsh-advisor-group
npm install --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund
npm run build
npm pack

readme.section: 当前 package.json 版本为 0.1.5，因此文件名如下：
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-advisor-group-0.1.5.tgz
```

桌面端安装源码包时，在 **Plugins → Add plugin** 中填写这个 `.tgz` 文件的绝对路径。安装后重启相应的 DSH 端。

readme.section: 路径一：让多位模型一起会诊
readme.text: 1. 打开 **设置 → 插件 → 顾问群**。 2. 至少添加一位顾问，选择供应商路由和模型；可用「获取模型列表」读取该线路的模型清单。 3. 在问题前加上 `@顾问群`，并交代必要背景。例如： ```text @顾问群 请评审这个插件的跨会话协作方案。 背景：DSH Web 与桌面端共用一份代码，要求不自动投递、不猜测目标会话。 ``` `@顾问群` 会强制发起会诊。普通专业问题也可以由主模型按规则升级；同一问题连续三次未解决，或主模型给出的置信度低于阈值，也会触发会诊。 设置页按使用路径分区，默认全部折叠；展开哪一节，就在那一节底部保存。

readme.section: 路径二：按名字询问另一个会话
readme.text:
1. 打开任意会话里的 **「顾问团」**标签页；标签栏空间不足时，它可能位于「…」菜单中。
2. 给目标会话填写「身份姓名」和「主要负责」，再点「加入顾问团」或「保存」。也可以点「用主模型生成」，检查建议后逐条保存，或用「保存全部更改」一次提交。
3. 回到对话，直接说：

```text
   去问一下小明：顾问团角色卡今天完成了哪些改动？
   ```

也可以一次问多位成员：

```text
   同时问小明和阿龙：分别检查这个方案在桌面端和 Web 端有没有遗漏，并汇总两边结论。
   ```

自动生成的内容只会填入草稿；**保存后才生效，已有卡不会被覆盖**。原来的会话标题、目录名和 sessionId 仍然可用。

readme.section: 多模型会诊：自动深挖，而不是只问一遍
readme.text: 一次 `ask_advisors` 会完成整场讨论： ```text 原问题 → 第 1 轮：顾问 A → 顾问 B（看过 A）→ 顾问 C（看过 A、B） → 后续轮：驱动模型提出更深追问 → 顾问按同样顺序接力 → 驱动模型生成综合结论

readme.section: 多模型会诊：自动深挖，而不是只问一遍
readme.text:
- **讨论轮数可控**：`maxRounds` 为 1–5，默认 2。关闭 `autoDeepen` 后，后续轮次重复使用原问题，综合结论仍会生成。
- **驱动模型复用当前会话线路**：负责深挖追问与综合结论，不需要另配一套模型；无法读取当前线路时使用 `discussion.driverModel` 兜底。
- **顾问可以使用会话工具**：默认只允许只读工具，调用过程进入卡片；最多 4 轮工具交互后必须用文字作答。工具范围可全局设置，也可按顾问覆盖。
- **流式卡片保留过程**：绿色 CRT 卡片按 `📋 行动 → 💭 思考 → ⛭ 工具 → 📄 正文`展示。思考和工具详情默认折叠，正文默认展开。
- **停止后可以从断点继续**：人工停止或宿主重启后，「▶ 继续聊天」只补未完成的顾问和轮次，不重新询问已经完成的顾问。
- **可选 Jev 前置判断**：默认关闭。开启后可判断是否该找顾问、是否高风险、是否更适合联网；Jev 不可用时回退到本地规则分类器。
- **12 个平台、28 个供应商预设**：DeepSeek、月之暗面 Kimi、Kimi Code、阿里云百炼、智谱 AI、OpenAI、Claude、Gemini、硅基流动、AIHubMix、OpenRouter、OpenCode Go。

readme.section: 顾问团：给会话一个稳定身份
readme.text: 会话标题适合描述窗口，却不一定适合长期称呼。顾问团把「姓名 + 职责」绑定到会话 id，并保存在本机 `$DSH_HOME/storages/advisor-group/corps.json`；它不会改写会话标题。

readme.section: 顾问团：给会话一个稳定身份
readme.text:
- 姓名全局唯一，不区分大小写；最长 40 个字符。职责最长 200 个字符。
- 「用主模型生成」使用**当前打开会话的模型**，每次最多为 12 个未分配会话生成建议，只填草稿，不自动保存。
- 可逐条修改、复制姓名、批量保存或移除。已归档、被排除、离开工作区或已不存在的会话，其角色卡会归入「未挂接」，可保留或删除。
- `list_sessions` 会显示角色姓名和职责；`ask_session`、`ask_sessions` 可以直接使用这个角色名，精确角色名优先于同名会话标题。

readme.section: 跨会话协作：问一个，也可以问一组
readme.text:
- **单人会话提问**：`ask_session` 默认同步等待，也可用 `detach: true` 立即返回 `askId`，稍后通过 `ask_result` 读取。
- **批量提问**：`ask_sessions` 一次向 1–8 个明确目标发送同一个问题。`mode: 'all'` 等全部目标结束；`mode: 'any'` 在首个目标结束后返回，其余目标继续完成并写入各自记录。
- **答案自动回送**：`swarm.deliverBack` 默认开启。完成（`done`）的答案会回送到提问会话；超时和出错不会自动回送。批量提问把完成答案合并为一条回送消息。
- **结果可追查**：每个被投递的目标都有独立 `askId`。异步记录可能是 `waiting`、`done`、`timeout`、`error` 或 `interrupted`；最后一个状态表示宿主重启使等待未能完成。
- **不猜目标**：`ask_session` 未点名时，路由只返回候选，不自动投递。`ask_sessions` 不做路由；无法解析、同名歧义或被排除的目标会列出跳过原因。
- **有明确的协作护栏**：最多 2 跳中转；不能问自己或子代理会话；同一提问会话同时只等待一个 `ask_session` 请求；问题和背景合计上限 32,000 字节；等待超时不会取消目标会话的回合。

readme.section: 跨会话协作：问一个，也可以问一组
readme.text: > **返回内容的准确含义**：工具取得的是目标会话从「投递回执」到「下一次整体空闲」之间说过的全部内容，不保证是逐条对应你那个问题的一段答案。结果中的 `status`（`ok` / `partial` / `failed`）用于说明这次收集的可靠性。

这些工具由主模型在会话中调用，**不是斜杠命令，也不需要你手写工具参数**。跨会话工具只应在你明确要求询问其他会话或窗口时使用。

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `ask_advisors` | 发起多模型会诊，或用 `sessionId + followUp` 追加一轮讨论 |
| `ask_session` | 询问一个已有会话；支持同步等待、异步投递和候选路由 |
| `ask_sessions` | 向 1–8 个明确目标批量提问；支持 `all` / `any` 两种收集方式 |
| `list_sessions` | 只读列出会话标题、目录、活跃状态及顾问团姓名和职责；不唤醒会话 |
| `ask_result` | 按 `askId` 读取异步结果，或查看当前会话最近发起的提问 |
| `toggle_advisor_group` | 启停多模型会诊功能，并持久化开关状态 |

| 配置键 | 默认值 | 什么时候调整 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `discussion.maxRounds` | `2` | 想减少成本时调低；想讨论更深时调高，最高 5 |
| `discussion.maxAdvisorsPerCall` | `3` | 控制每次参与会诊的顾问人数，范围 1–10 |
| `discussion.advisorTools` | `'readonly'` | 改为 `'off'` 禁止顾问用工具；`'all'` 仅用于充分信任的场景 |
| `quota.enabled` / `quota.maxPerDay` | `true` / `50` | 设置每日新会诊上限；关闭上限后仍统计次数 |
| `swarm.defaultMode` | `'wait'` | 改为 `'detach'`，让跨会话提问默认异步投递 |
| `swarm.defaultWaitMs` | `180000` | 调整默认等待上限，范围 1000–600000 毫秒 |
| `swarm.deliverBack` | `true` | 关闭后，完成答案只通过 `ask_result` 读取，不自动回送 |

| 配置键 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |

| `advisors[].reasoningEffort` | string | – | `off` / `low` / `high` / `max`；未设置时跟随供应商或模型默认 |
| `advisors[].temperature` | number | – | 采样温度，0–2 |
| `advisors[].maxTokens` | number | – | 单次回答的 token 上限，至少 1 |
| `advisors[].authMode` | string | – | Anthropic 直连的鉴权头：`x-api-key` / `bear
顾问工具调用仅直连的 OpenAI / Anthropic 通道支持。DSH 内置通道可复用宿主凭据进行普通回答，但不支持这里的顾问工具循环。

| 配置键 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger.requireClassifier` | boolean | `true` | 非强制会诊发起前先进行前置分类 |
| `trigger.allowWebFallback` | boolean | `true` | 分类器认为更适合联网时，返回不启动会诊的提示 |
| `trigger.confidenceThreshold` | number | `0.6` | 主模型置信度低于此值时允许升级，范围 0–1 |
| `trigger.jev.enabled` | boolean | `false` | 使用 Jev 做语义前置分类；失败时回退本地规则 |
| `trigger.jev.provider` / `trigger.jev.model` | string | `'typesafe'` / `'jev-latest'` | Jev 线路与模型；线路也可设为 `openrouter` |
| `trigger.jev.baseURL` | string | – | 可选自定义 Jev 地址 |
| `trigger.jev.apiKey` / `trigger.jev.apiKeyEnv` | string | – | Jev 密钥或保存密钥的环境变量名；密钥字段按 secret 处理 |
| `trigger.jev.timeoutMs` | number | `10000` | Jev 请求超时，1000–60000 毫秒 |
| `trigger.jev.confidenceThreshold` | number | `0.6` | 判定需要顾问的阈值 |
| `trigger.jev.highRiskThreshold` | number | 跟随上一项 | 高风险判定阈值；未设置时跟随 `trigger.jev.confidenceThreshold` |
| `trigger.jev.useEnglishState` | boolean | `false` | 开启后，Jev 使用调用方提供的英文概要 `questionEn`；卡片和会话记录仍保留原始问题 |

| 配置键 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `swarm.enabled` | boolean | `true` | 跨会话总开关；关闭后四个跨会话工具会明确拒绝调用 |
| `swarm.defaultMode` | string | `'wait'` | `ask_session` 默认同步等待或异步投递：`wait` / `detach` |
| `swarm.defaultWaitMs` | number | `180000` | 默认等待上限，1000–600000 毫秒 |
| `swarm.resultTtlHours` | number | `24` | 异步结果保留时间，1–720 小时 |
| `swarm.deliverBack` | boolean | `true` | 自动回送 `done` 答案；`timeout` / `error` 不自动回送 |
| `swarm.rosterIncludeSubagents` | boolean | `false` | 名录是否显示子代理；这不改变投递工具禁止以子代理为目标的规则 |
| `swarm.routingEnabled` | boolean | `true` | `ask_session` 未点名时是否按问题给出候选；只给候选，不自动投递 |
| `swarm.routingTopN` | number | `3` | 候选数量，1–8 |
| `swarm.routingEngine` | string | `'local'` | `local` 本地排序，或 `jev` 重排闭合候选；Jev 失败时回退本地 |
| `swarm.routingAsk` | string | `'gated'` | 是否建议跨会话提问：`off` / `gated` / `always`；建议不等于投递 |
| `swarm.routingExclude` | string[] | `[]` | 不参与蜂群的会话；不出现在名录或候选中，被点名也会拒绝 |

`discussion.parallel` 与 `discussion.stopOnConsensus` 已弃用，只为读取旧配置保留。

`ui.theme`、`ui.showTimestamps`、`ui.autoExpand` 同样是历史配置字段；当前客户端没有读取它们，修改这些值不会改变卡片外观或展开行为。当前卡片为绿色 CRT 样式，思考与工具详情默认折叠。

</details>

完成 `R` 轮讨论、每轮有 `N` 位顾问且没有工具调用时，一场会诊通常包含 **`R × (N + 1)` 次模型调用**：`R × N` 次顾问回答、`R - 1` 次深挖追问，以及 1 次综合结论。按默认轮数 `R = 2`、每场实际有 3 位顾问参与计算时为 8 次。

实际费用还取决于以下行为：

- 顾问的工具往返会增加模型调用；驱动模型与各位顾问按各自线路分别计费。
- 「用主模型生成」角色卡会对当前会话模型发起调用；Jev 分类或路由开启后也按相应线路计费。
- 跨会话提问不占用顾问会诊配额，但会唤醒目标会话，消耗目标会话自己的模型额度。批量提问按各个目标分别计算。

每日配额按 **UTC 日历日**统计新发起的会诊，默认 50 次。续跑、后续追问和跨会话提问不占用这项配额。计数保存在 `$DSH_HOME/storages/advisor-group/daily-guard.json`；关闭上限后仍计数，但不拦截。需要控制成本时，可减少轮数或顾问人数、关闭顾问工具，并设置每日上限。

- **密钥不回显**：直连 API Key 保存在本机 DSH 配置中，按 `SecretField` 语义处理，不返回浏览器。不希望密钥写入配置时，可使用 `apiKeyEnv`。
- **本地路由有令牌**：`/advisor-group/*` 使用每次启动生成的共享 token，面向本地单用户场景。需要暴露到局域网或公网时，必须在外层增加反向代理鉴权。
- **诊断请求有限制**：模型列表和连接测试在服务端请求供应商，并校验目标 URL、协议和重定向。DNS rebinding 仍是已知的架构边界。
- **谨慎使用 `advisorTools: 'all'`**：它会把当前会话所有可见工具交给顾问，包括写文件和执行命令；调用仍经过 DSH 的工具管线与权限守卫。日常使用建议保持 `readonly` 或 `off`，非只读工具调用会写入警告日志。
- **跨会话内容会留痕**：问题和背景会永久写入目标会话日志，因此只发送必要信息。角色卡生成会把会话标题、工作目录和活跃提示交给当前主模型；角色卡本身保存在本机，不包含 API Key。
- **本地状态集中保存**：会诊快照、异步提问记录、角色卡和配额数据位于 `$DSH_HOME/storages/advisor-group/`。分类器影子日志仅用于阈值调优，不参与运行决策。

- DSH 宿主突然崩溃时，未刷新的卡片可能仍显示 **LIVE**；页面刷新后会根据持久化日志恢复真实状态。前端已有断线提示。
- 风险提示只根据客观状态生成：超时或网络中断造成的截断，以及人工停止造成的取消。插件不再通过扫描顾问正文里的“风险”“不确定”等词来猜测风险。
- 跨会话工具目前没有按单个会话独立隐藏的开关。`swarm.enabled` 开启时四个工具对会话可见，关闭后调用会明确拒绝；两个会话互相等待的死锁目前也不会被专门检测。
- 角色卡面板最多显示 50 个可见会话；自动生成每次最多处理 12 个未分配会话，可以再次生成以继续补齐。

For a source-built desktop installation, enter the `.tgz` file's absolute path under **Plugins → Add plugin**. Restart the corresponding DSH application after installation.

1. Open **Settings → Plugins → 顾问群 (Advisor Group)**.
2. Add at least one advisor and select its provider route and model. Use **获取模型列表** (Fetch model list) to retrieve the route's model catalogue.
3. Prefix your question with `@顾问群` and include the necessary background. For example:

```text
   @顾问群 Review this plugin's cross-session collaboration design.
   Background: DSH Web and desktop share one codebase. The design must never deliver automatically or guess a target session.
   ```

`@顾问群` forces a consultation. The main model can also escalate ordinary professional questions under its routing rules, including when the same unresolved question appears three times or its reported confidence falls below the threshold.
The settings page follows the setup path, with every section folded by default; each open section has its own save row.

Generated cards only fill drafts; **they take effect only after you save them, and existing cards are never overwritten**. Session titles, working-directory names, and sessionIds remain valid target spellings.

readme.section: Multi-model consultation: deepen the discussion automatically
readme.text: One `ask_advisors` call runs the whole consultation: ```text Original question → Round 1: Advisor A → Advisor B (sees A) → Advisor C (sees A and B) → Later rounds: a deeper driver question → the same advisor relay → A synthesis from the driver model

readme.section: Multi-model consultation: deepen the discussion automatically
readme.text:
- **Controlled rounds**: `maxRounds` ranges from 1 to 5 and defaults to 2. With `autoDeepen` disabled, later rounds repeat the original question; the final synthesis is still generated.
- **No separate driver route to configure**: the driver writes follow-ups and the synthesis through the current session's provider and model. It falls back to `discussion.driverModel` when that route cannot be read.
- **Advisors can use session tools**: the default scope is read-only. Calls appear in the card, and after at most four tool rounds the advisor must answer in text. Set the scope globally or override it per advisor.
- **A streaming card that preserves the process**: the green CRT card renders `📋 Action → 💭 Thinking → ⛭ Tool → 📄 Response`. Thinking and tool details start collapsed; the response starts expanded.
- **Resume from the checkpoint**: after a manual stop or host restart, **▶ 继续聊天** (Resume chat) completes only the missing advisors and rounds instead of asking completed advisors again.
- **Optional Jev pre-classification**: off by default. When enabled, Jev can judge whether advisors are needed, whether the request is high-risk, and whether web search is more appropriate. Failures

readme.section: Advisor Corps: give each session a durable identity
readme.text: A session title describes a window, but it may not be a durable way to address that session. Advisor Corps binds a **name and duty** to the session id and stores it locally in `$DSH_HOME/storages/advisor-group/corps.json`; it never renames the session.

readme.section: Advisor Corps: give each session a durable identity
Advisor Corps: give each session a durable identity
readme.text:
- Names are globally unique and case-insensitive, with a 40-character limit. Duties can contain up to 200 characters.
- **Generate with main model** uses the model of the **currently open conversation**. Each pass proposes cards for at most 12 unassigned sessions, fills drafts only, and never saves automatically.
- Edit rows, copy role names, save in batch, or remove cards. Cards whose sessions are archived, excluded, outside every workspace, or no longer present appear under **未挂接** (Unlinked), where you can keep or delete them.
- `list_sessions` includes role names and duties. `ask_session` and `ask_sessions` accept an exact role name, which takes precedence over a session title with the same name.

readme.section: Cross-session collaboration: ask one session or a group
readme.text:
- **Single-session asks**: `ask_session` waits synchronously by default. With `detach: true`, it returns an `askId` immediately so you can read the result later through `ask_result`.
- **Batch asks**: `ask_sessions` sends one question to 1–8 explicit targets. `mode: 'all'` waits for every target; `mode: 'any'` returns when the first target settles while the others continue and write their own records.
- **Automatic answer copy-back**: `swarm.deliverBack` is enabled by default. Answers that finish as `done` are copied back into the asking session; timeouts and errors are not. A batch combines all completed answers into one copy-back message.
- **Traceable results**: every delivered target gets its own `askId`. An asynchronous record can be `waiting`, `done`, `timeout`, `error`, or `interrupted`; the last state means a host restart prevented the wait from completing.
- **No guessed targets**: when `ask_session` has no target, routing returns candidates without delivering anything. `ask_sessions` performs no routing; unresolved, ambiguous, or excluded targets are reported in its skipped list with reasons.
- **Explicit collaboration guards**: at most two relay hops; no self or subagent

readme.section: Cross-session collaboration: ask one session or a group
readme.text: > **What the returned text means**: the tool collects everything the target says between the **delivery receipt** and its next **whole-session idle**. It is not guaranteed to be a one-to-one answer to your question. The `status` field (`ok` / `partial` / `failed`) describes the reliability of that collection.

The main model calls these tools inside a conversation. **They are not slash commands, and you do not need to write tool arguments yourself.** Cross-session tools should be used only when you explicitly ask to contact another session or window.

| `ask_sessions` | Ask 1–8 explicit targets in a batch; supports `all` and `any` collection modes |
| `list_sessions` | Read session titles, directories, activity, and Advisor Corps names and duties without waking anyone |
| `ask_result` | Read one asynchronous result by `askId`, or list recent asks started by this session |
| `toggle_advisor_group` | Enable or disable multi-model consultation and persist the setting |

`ui.theme`, `ui.showTimestamps`, and `ui.autoExpand` are also legacy fields. The current client does not read them, so changing them has no effect on the card's appearance or expansion behavior. The current card uses a green CRT style; thinking and tool details start collapsed.

A consultation that completes `R` rounds with `N` advisors and no tool calls normally makes **`R × (N + 1)` model calls**: `R × N` advisor responses, `R - 1` deepening questions, and one final synthesis. With the default `R = 2` and three advisors actually participating, this produces 8 calls.

Actual usage also depends on these behaviors:

- Advisor tool loops add model calls. The driver and every advisor are billed through their respective routes.
- Generating role cards calls the current conversation's model. Jev classification or routing is also billed through its configured route when enabled.
- Cross-session asks do not consume the advisor-consultation quota, but they wake target sessions and consume each target's own model quota. Batch asks are accounted for per target.

The daily quota counts **new consultations per UTC calendar day**, with a default cap of 50. Resumes, follow-up rounds, and cross-session asks do not consume this quota. The counter lives in `$DSH_HOME/storages/advisor-group/daily-guard.json`; disabling the cap keeps counting without blocking requests. To control cost, reduce rounds or advisors, disable advisor tools, and set a daily cap.

- **Keys are not returned to the browser**: direct API keys are stored in the local DSH configuration under `SecretField` semantics. Use `apiKeyEnv` if you prefer not to write a key into that configuration.
- **Local routes require a token**: `/advisor-group/*` uses a shared token generated at startup and is designed for a local single-user setup. Add reverse-proxy authentication before exposing it to a LAN or the public internet.
- **Diagnostic requests are constrained**: model-list and connection-test calls run server-side and validate the target URL, protocol, and redirects. DNS rebinding remains a known architectural boundary.
- **Use `advisorTools: 'all'` with care**: it exposes every session-visible tool to advisors, including file writes and command execution. Calls still pass through DSH's tool pipeline and permission guards. Keep `readonly` or `off` for everyday use; non-read-only tool calls emit warning logs.
- **Cross-session content leaves a record**: questions and context are permanently recorded in target session logs, so send only what is necessary. Role-card generation sends session titles, working directories, and activity hints to the current main model. The cards

- After an abrupt DSH host crash, an unrefreshed card may still display **LIVE**. Refreshing restores its actual state from the persisted session log; the client already shows a disconnection notice.
- Risk notices are based on objective events: truncation caused by timeout or network interruption, and cancellation caused by a manual stop. The plugin no longer guesses risk by scanning advisor prose for words such as “risk” or “uncertain”.
- Cross-session tools have no per-session visibility switch. When `swarm.enabled` is on, all four tools are visible to sessions; when off, calls are refused explicitly. Mutual waits between two sessions are not specifically detected as deadlocks.
- The Advisor Corps panel displays at most 50 visible sessions. Automatic generation handles at most 12 unassigned sessions per pass; run it again to continue filling the roster.
